7.7. Commercial Operation
The IC must provide notification to the MISO (email to: ResourceIntegration@misoenergy.org)
and Transmission Owner after the project achieves Commercial Operation. Such notification is
provided in the form of Appendix E to the GIA and must be received by MISO within thirty (30)
Calendar Days of the actual Commercial Operation Date. The notification should also include as
built modeling data of the plant. Attachment A of the application can be used to provide such data.
After submitting the required notification of actual Commercial Operation Date, the IC may initiate
any remaining refund by emailing a request to gifinance@misoenergy.org (including project
numbers(s) and date of Commercial Operation). MISO will review the project account for any
applicable refunds after receipt of the request for refund.
